dialogues.jp: 「服、どうしようかな……」
dialogues.en: "Girl's clothes......"
dialogues.text: "Girl's clothes......"

dialogues.jp:
時刻は５時。そろそろ外食の事を告げようと思
うのだが、割と重要な事を思い出したのだ。
dialogues.en:
"She could borrow clothes, but I'm not sure about her
size......"
dialogues.text:
"She could borrow clothes, but I'm not sure about her
size......"

dialogues.jp:
つまり、頼子さんの外出着はどうするのかとい
う。
dialogues.en:
"Nemu...... She must have taken all her clothes with
her......"
dialogues.text:
"Nemu...... She must have taken all her clothes with
her......"

dialogues.jp:
「昼間も思ったけど、やっぱメイド服で町中を
　｛かっぽ／闊歩｝するのは妙だよな……」
dialogues.en:
It'd be easier if we can go buy her clothes together, but
the point is she doesn't have clothes to wear for the
shopping...
dialogues.text:
It'd be easier if we can go buy her clothes together, but
the point is she doesn't have clothes to wear for the
shopping...

dialogues.jp:
俺は構わないが、頼子さんに好奇の視線が集ま
るかと思うと腹が立つ。
dialogues.en: "Oh well, she can wear mine."
dialogues.text: "Oh well, she can wear mine."

dialogues.jp: 「女物の服……か」
dialogues.en:
I take out jeans and a white shirt from my closet. It
shouldn't look too strange even if a woman wears them.
dialogues.text:
I take out jeans and a white shirt from my closet. It
shouldn't look too strange even if a woman wears them.

dialogues.jp:
「さくらんぼに借りる──いや、サイズが合わ
　ないな」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp:
「音夢……は、みんな持っていっているだろう
　しな……」
dialogues.en:
In the living room, Yoriko-san's cleaning the window. She
sprays a glass cleaner on the window.
dialogues.text:
In the living room, Yoriko-san's cleaning the window. She
sprays a glass cleaner on the window.

dialogues.jp:
買いに行くのが一番なのだが、それに着ていく
服もないと来てる。
dialogues.en:
She doesn't notice when I come into the living room and she
keeps cleaning the window.
dialogues.text:
She doesn't notice when I come into the living room and she
keeps cleaning the window.

dialogues.jp: 「しゃーないな、俺の服でいいか」
dialogues.en: (She really is a hard worker......)
dialogues.text: (She really is a hard worker......)

dialogues.jp:
クローゼットからジーンズと白いＹシャツを取
り出した。
dialogues.en: After she finishes one window, I talk to her.
dialogues.text: After she finishes one window, I talk to her.

dialogues.jp: まあ、女性が着てもおかしくはないはず。
dialogues.en: "Yoriko-san."
dialogues.text: "Yoriko-san."

dialogues.jp: 「さて」
dialogues.en: "Ah, yes?"
dialogues.text: "Ah, yes?"

dialogues.jp:
居間では、頼子さんが窓ガラスを｛ふ／拭｝いていた。
ガラスには、専用のスプレーが吹き付けられて
いる。
dialogues.en:
She doesn't just turn her head around to answer, but she
nicely turns around and faces me.
dialogues.text:
She doesn't just turn her head around to answer, but she
nicely turns around and faces me.

dialogues.jp:
俺が入ってきた事に気づかず、頼子さんの背中
はデンプシーロールのように忙しい。
dialogues.en: "Yes, what can I do for you......?"
dialogues.text: "Yes, what can I do for you......?"

dialogues.jp: （ほんと、仕事熱心だよな……）
dialogues.en: "Ah, you haven't cooked dinner yet, have you?"
dialogues.text: "Ah, you haven't cooked dinner yet, have you?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、はい」
dialogues.en: "Ah, no...... Are you hungry?"
dialogues.text: "Ah, no...... Are you hungry?"

dialogues.jp:
首だけねじるというような事はせずに、きちん
とこちらに正面を向ける。
dialogues.en: "No, not yet. I had a lot of lasagna for lunch."
dialogues.text: "No, not yet. I had a lot of lasagna for lunch."

dialogues.jp:
実際、頼子さんの作ったラザニアは驚くくらい
美味しかった。
dialogues.en: Actually the lasagna she made was surprisingly delicious.
dialogues.text: Actually the lasagna she made was surprisingly delicious.

dialogues.jp:
「今夜はさ、外に食べに行こうと思うんだけど、
　どうだろ？」
dialogues.en:
"I was thinking we should go out for dinner tonight. What do
you think?"
dialogues.text:
"I was thinking we should go out for dinner tonight. What do
you think?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「外に……ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Outside......?"
dialogues.text: "Outside......?"

dialogues.jp:
浮かんだ難色に気がついたが、構わず先を進め
る。
dialogues.en: She looks reluctant, but I keep on.
dialogues.text: She looks reluctant, but I keep on.

dialogues.jp:
「ほら、今日、日曜だったし。メイドのお仕事
　にも休みは必要だと思うんだけど」
dialogues.en: "See, today's Sunday. You should get a break, too."
dialogues.text: "See, today's Sunday. You should get a break, too."

dialogues.jp:
「着替えは、ちょっと申し訳ないんだけど、俺
　のやつでいいかな」
dialogues.en: "And you can wear my clothes."
dialogues.text: "And you can wear my clothes."

dialogues.jp:
テーブルの上を示す。たたまれたジーンズとシャ
ツが置いてある。
dialogues.en: I point at the table. My jeans and shirt are on the table.
dialogues.text: I point at the table. My jeans and shirt are on the table.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「あ、で、でも……今夜はロールキャベツを
　……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, b-but...... I was going to make stuffed cabbage..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, b-but...... I was going to make stuffed cabbage..."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「ま、ま、それは明日でも食べれるし。たまに
　はさ、外出もいいんじゃないかな？」
dialogues.en:
"Well, we can eat that tomorrow. I think it's okay to eat
out sometimes."
dialogues.text:
"Well, we can eat that tomorrow. I think it's okay to eat
out sometimes."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、は、はい……。そう……ですね」
dialogues.en: "Ah, y-yes...... You're... right."
dialogues.text: "Ah, y-yes...... You're... right."

dialogues.jp:
｛うつむ／俯｝き、言葉とは裏腹の雰囲気を漂わせている。
“やっぱり家で食べようか”そう言いたい欲求
に駆られたが、何とかそれを押さえつけた。
dialogues.en:
She seems reluctant despite her answer. I almost want to say
"We can eat out next time. Let's eat at home tonight." But I
don't.
dialogues.text:
She seems reluctant despite her answer. I almost want to say
"We can eat out next time. Let's eat at home tonight." But I
don't.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、７時頃にね」
dialogues.en: "Okay. Then, we'll leave around 7pm."
dialogues.text: "Okay. Then, we'll leave around 7pm."

dialogues.jp:
そんな言葉を後に残して、俺は自分の部屋へと
引っ込んだのだった。
dialogues.en: I tell her that and walk back to my room.
dialogues.text: I tell her that and walk back to my room.

dialogues.jp: 「さて……と」

反動を付け、ベッドから起きあがる。時計の短
針は、７を差していた。
dialogues.en:
I get up from my bed. The short hand of the clock's pointing
at 7.
dialogues.text:
I get up from my bed. The short hand of the clock's pointing
at 7.

dialogues.jp: 「待ってる時間って、ほんと長いよな……」
dialogues.en: "It feels longer when you're waiting...... huh?"
dialogues.text: "It feels longer when you're waiting...... huh?"

dialogues.jp:
｛こうこつ／恍惚｝と不安、二つながら我にありってなもので
ある。
dialogues.en: I'm both excited and anxious.
dialogues.text: I'm both excited and anxious.

dialogues.jp:
はてさて、頼子さんとの初めての外出はどうな
るのやら……。
dialogues.en: I wonder how it's going to be......
dialogues.text: I wonder how it's going to be......

dialogues.jp:
俺はちょろっと鏡で髪型なんぞを確認すると、
階段を下りていった。
dialogues.en:
I look at a mirror to check if my hair looks okay, and go
downstairs.
dialogues.text:
I look at a mirror to check if my hair looks okay, and go
downstairs.

dialogues.jp:
「頼子さん、そろそろ時間だけど──って、ま
　だ着替えてなかったの？」
dialogues.en:
"Yoriko-san, it's time to go...... Oh, you haven't changed
yet?"
dialogues.text:
"Yoriko-san, it's time to go...... Oh, you haven't changed
yet?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、は、はい、その……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, n-no, I... I haven't......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, n-no, I... I haven't......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ほらほら、さっさと着替えて」
dialogues.en: "Change your clothes quickly and let's go."
dialogues.text: "Change your clothes quickly and let's go."

dialogues.jp:
椅子に腰掛けている頼子さんを立たせ、脱衣所
まで引っ張っていく。
dialogues.en:
She's sitting on a chair, but I make her stand up and pull
her hand to the bathroom so she can change.
dialogues.text:
She's sitting on a chair, but I make her stand up and pull
her hand to the bathroom so she can change.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、あの……お待たせしました……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, thank you for waiting......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, thank you for waiting......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「おお」
dialogues.en: "Oh."
dialogues.text: "Oh."

dialogues.jp:
メイド服ばかり見ていたから、こういう服装の
頼子さんはかなり新鮮だった。
dialogues.en:
Since I've never seen her in anything but a maid costume,
seeing her in this kind of clothes is very interesting.
dialogues.text:
Since I've never seen her in anything but a maid costume,
seeing her in this kind of clothes is very interesting.

dialogues.jp:
「あ……けど、それ、大丈夫かな？　やっぱ、
　目立つか……？」
dialogues.en:
"Ah...... but what are you going to do with those? They're
still standing out......"
dialogues.text:
"Ah...... but what are you going to do with those? They're
still standing out......"

dialogues.jp:
俺の視線に、頼子さんは不安げにネコ耳に手を
伸ばした。
dialogues.en: Yoriko reaches her hands nervously to her cat ears.
dialogues.text: Yoriko reaches her hands nervously to her cat ears.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「そう……ですね。けど、この服装なら、人の
　目はあまり……」
dialogues.en:
"They are...... But with these clothes, it's better and
stands out less, I think......"
dialogues.text:
"They are...... But with these clothes, it's better and
stands out less, I think......"

dialogues.jp:
確かに、メイド服よりは目立たない格好ではあ
るだろう。
dialogues.en: She's right. She stands out less with those clothes.
dialogues.text: She's right. She stands out less with those clothes.

dialogues.jp:
「ま、大丈夫か。俺も居るしな。それじゃ、行
　こう」
dialogues.en: "Oh well. I'm with you, so don't worry. Let's go."
dialogues.text: "Oh well. I'm with you, so don't worry. Let's go."

dialogues.jp: 財布の中身を確認すると、玄関へと向かう。
dialogues.en:
I check my wallet to see how much I have and walk to the
door.
dialogues.text:
I check my wallet to see how much I have and walk to the
door.

dialogues.jp: 「で、頼子さんは何が食べ──って、あら」
dialogues.en: "So what do you want to eat...... Yoriko-san?"
dialogues.text: "So what do you want to eat...... Yoriko-san?"

dialogues.jp: 振り返ると、そこには誰も居ない。
dialogues.en: I turn around and there's no one.
dialogues.text: I turn around and there's no one.

dialogues.jp: 「ほら、ぼうっとしてないで、行こうよ」
dialogues.en: "What's wrong? Let's go."
dialogues.text: "What's wrong? Let's go."

dialogues.jp:
手を取り、軽く引く。顔を伏せたままこくんと
頷くと、頼子さんは歩を進めた。
dialogues.en:
I take her hand and gently pull her to step forward. She
nods without looking up and starts to walk.
dialogues.text:
I take her hand and gently pull her to step forward. She
nods without looking up and starts to walk.

dialogues.jp: 「で、頼子さんは何が食べたい？」
dialogues.en: "So what do you want to eat?"
dialogues.text: "So what do you want to eat?"

dialogues.jp: 綱引きのように、手が強く引っ張られる。
dialogues.en: "Yoriko-san?"
dialogues.text: "Yoriko-san?"

dialogues.jp:
驚いて振り向くと、頼子さんは明らかに｛おび／怯｝えの
表情を浮かべていた。
dialogues.en:
My hand gets pulled back hard. As I turn around in surprise,
she's looking obviously scared.
dialogues.text:
My hand gets pulled back hard. As I turn around in surprise,
she's looking obviously scared.

dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと、頼子さん？」
dialogues.en: "Are you all right, Yoriko-san?"
dialogues.text: "Are you all right, Yoriko-san?"

dialogues.jp:
ずりずりと、腰を落として後ずさる。手を離す
と勢いで転んでしまいそうで、俺は握る手に力
を込めた。
dialogues.en:
She steps backward, her hip lowering down. If I let go of
her hand, she might fall down on the ground, so I tighten my
grip on her hand.
dialogues.text:
She steps backward, her hip lowering down. If I let go of
her hand, she might fall down on the ground, so I tighten my
grip on her hand.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「や……いやなんです……いや……」
dialogues.en: "I...... don't want to go......"
dialogues.text: "I...... don't want to go......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「やあああぁぁっ……！！」

ついにぺたんと尻が地面にくっつき、腕だけが
空中に投げ出されている形となる。
dialogues.en:
Her hips touch the ground, and only her arm is up in the
air, connected to my hand.
dialogues.text:
Her hips touch the ground, and only her arm is up in the
air, connected to my hand.

dialogues.jp:
膝を立て、その間に顔をうずめてしまった。程
なくして、低いすすり泣きが聞こえてくる。
dialogues.en:
She sits down with her knees up to her chest. Then I hear
her sobbing.
dialogues.text:
She sits down with her knees up to her chest. Then I hear
her sobbing.

dialogues.jp: 「分かった。分かったから」
dialogues.en: "Okay, okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay, okay."

dialogues.jp:
しゃがみ込み、肩を抱いて、｛はげ／励｝ますように軽く
叩いた。
dialogues.en:
I bend down to hold her shoulders and give her a gentle pat
to cheer her up.
dialogues.text:
I bend down to hold her shoulders and give her a gentle pat
to cheer her up.

dialogues.jp: 「外食は止めにしよう。な？」
dialogues.en: "Let's not eat out tonight. Okay?"
dialogues.text: "Let's not eat out tonight. Okay?"

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんを何とか立ち上がらせ、閉めたばかり
の鍵を開ける。
dialogues.en:
I make her stand up and unlock the door which I just locked
a few minutes ago.
dialogues.text:
I make her stand up and unlock the door which I just locked
a few minutes ago.

dialogues.jp: 「ほら、頼子さん。とりあえず顔洗って」
dialogues.en: "Yoriko-san, why don't you wash your face first?"
dialogues.text: "Yoriko-san, why don't you wash your face first?"

dialogues.jp:
くたくたと力のない身体を支え、何とか洗面所
へ連れていく。
dialogues.en: I hold up her weak body and walk to the bathroom with her.
dialogues.text: I hold up her weak body and walk to the bathroom with her.

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんは、顔を手で｛おお／覆｝い、泣き続けるばかり
だった。
dialogues.en: She's covering her face with her hands and keeps crying.
dialogues.text: She's covering her face with her hands and keeps crying.

dialogues.jp: （こんなに拒否反応が強いなんて……）
dialogues.en: (She wanted that much not to go out......)
dialogues.text: (She wanted that much not to go out......)

dialogues.jp: 考えの足りなかった自分に腹が立つ。
dialogues.en:
It's my fault that I didn't think enough, and I'm mad at
myself.
dialogues.text:
It's my fault that I didn't think enough, and I'm mad at
myself.

dialogues.jp: 「バカバカッ、俺のバカッ！」
dialogues.en: "Stupid, stupid, I'm so stupid!"
dialogues.text: "Stupid, stupid, I'm so stupid!"

dialogues.jp:
水がパシャパシャいう音を耳にしながら、頭を
ぽかぽかと殴りつける。
dialogues.en:
Listening to the water gently hitting her face, I'm hitting
my head with my fists.
dialogues.text:
Listening to the water gently hitting her face, I'm hitting
my head with my fists.

dialogues.jp: 「……痛……いってえ！」
腫れていた額が、じんじんと地響きをたてた。
dialogues.en: My swollen forehead starts to throb.
dialogues.text: My swollen forehead starts to throb.

dialogues.jp:
カップを両手で包み込むようにして、口元へと
持っていく。
dialogues.en:
She holds a cup of coffee with both hands and brings it to
her mouth.
dialogues.text:
She holds a cup of coffee with both hands and brings it to
her mouth.

dialogues.jp:
こくんと熱いコーヒーを飲み込むと、頼子さん
はひとつ息をついた。
dialogues.en: After taking a sip of the hot coffee, Yoriko gives a sigh.
dialogues.text: After taking a sip of the hot coffee, Yoriko gives a sigh.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「申し訳……ありませんでした」
dialogues.en: "I am terribly sorry......"
dialogues.text: "I am terribly sorry......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「もう……平気です」
dialogues.en: "I'm fine...... now."
dialogues.text: "I'm fine...... now."

dialogues.jp:
顔だけ見るとまだ心配なのだが、確かに口調は
普段のものに戻っていた。
dialogues.en:
Her face isn't so convincing, but the tone of her voice is
back to normal.
dialogues.text:
Her face isn't so convincing, but the tone of her voice is
back to normal.

dialogues.jp:
さっきまですんすん鳴らしていた鼻も、今では
静かなものだった。
dialogues.en: Her sobbing's stopped as well.
dialogues.text: Her sobbing's stopped as well.

dialogues.jp: 「外に出るのが、そんなに嫌なんだ？」
dialogues.en: "So you don't like to go outside, huh?"
dialogues.text: "So you don't like to go outside, huh?"

dialogues.jp:
沈黙。頼子さんは手元にじっと視線を落とし、
俺の視界には、カップの見慣れた模様が大きく
映し出されている。
dialogues.en:
Silence. She's staring at her cup and I'm also staring at
the familiar picture of the cup.
dialogues.text:
Silence. She's staring at her cup and I'm also staring at
the familiar picture of the cup.

dialogues.jp: ただ、静かな時間が流れていく。
dialogues.en: The time of silence continues.
dialogues.text: The time of silence continues.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "......That's right."
dialogues.text: "......That's right."

dialogues.jp:
沈黙と耳鳴りの区別が付かなくなった頃、頼子
さんはそう言った。
dialogues.en:
It's almost to the point where I can't tell the difference
between silence and ear ringing, when she finally answers.
dialogues.text:
It's almost to the point where I can't tell the difference
between silence and ear ringing, when she finally answers.

dialogues.jp:
何に対する肯定なのか一瞬混乱して、次の言葉
に話の流れを思い出す。
dialogues.en:
I almost forget what I asked her, so I'm confused. Then I
finally remember my question when she continues,
dialogues.text:
I almost forget what I asked her, so I'm confused. Then I
finally remember my question when she continues,

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「私……外が、怖いんです」
dialogues.en: "I'm...... scared of outside."
dialogues.text: "I'm...... scared of outside."

dialogues.jp:
顔を上げると、そこには一体の綺麗な彫像が居
た。表情も姿勢も、さっきと同じまま。
dialogues.en:
I look up and see a beautiful sculpture. No change in the
expression of the face or the posture. Nothing has moved a
bit.
dialogues.text:
I look up and see a beautiful sculpture. No change in the
expression of the face or the posture. Nothing has moved a
bit.

dialogues.jp:
「それは……その、石とか投げつけられたりし
　たから？」
dialogues.en: "Because...... someone threw stones at you before?"
dialogues.text: "Because...... someone threw stones at you before?"

dialogues.jp:
あの日の出来事を思い出す。だとしたら──も
うちょっと、強く殴っておけば良かった。
dialogues.en: I remember that day. If that's the reason ---- @
dialogues.text: I remember that day. If that's the reason ---- @

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「いえ、それは……」
dialogues.en: "No, it's not that......"
dialogues.text: "No, it's not that......"

dialogues.jp:
かすかに首を振る。と、彫像に命が通い、表情
が生まれた。
dialogues.en:
It slightly shakes its head side to side. Then finally the
heart of the sculpture start to beat and make its
expression.
dialogues.text:
It slightly shakes its head side to side. Then finally the
heart of the sculpture start to beat and make its
expression.

dialogues.jp: （なんだろうな、その顔は……）
dialogues.en: (Why is she making that face......)
dialogues.text: (Why is she making that face......)

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんには初めての類の表情で、いまいち感
情が読みとれない。
dialogues.en:
I've never seen her face like that, and it's difficult for
me to read what she's thinking about.
dialogues.text:
I've never seen her face like that, and it's difficult for
me to read what she's thinking about.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「自分でも……分からないんです」
dialogues.en: "I don't know why myself either......"
dialogues.text: "I don't know why myself either......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「気が付いたら、そんな風で……。駄目……で
　すね、私……」
dialogues.en:
"As long as I can remember, I've been like this...... I'm
terrible......"
dialogues.text:
"As long as I can remember, I've been like this...... I'm
terrible......"

dialogues.jp:
ああ。口調と表情が結びついて、ひとつの感情
を描き出した。それは、｛じちょう／自嘲｝だ。
dialogues.en:
Now I see it. The tone of her voice and the expression on
her face are finally connected in a line and draw an
emotion. It's self-derision.
dialogues.text:
Now I see it. The tone of her voice and the expression on
her face are finally connected in a line and draw an
emotion. It's self-derision.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ごめんなさい……」
dialogues.en: "I am sorry......"
dialogues.text: "I am sorry......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ひとりにして……いただけますか……」
dialogues.en: "Could you...... leave me alone......?"
dialogues.text: "Could you...... leave me alone......?"

dialogues.jp: 蚊の鳴くような声で呟き、きゅっと目をつむる。
dialogues.en: She says very quietly, closing her eyes tightly.
dialogues.text: She says very quietly, closing her eyes tightly.

dialogues.jp: 「分かった」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp: ガタンと席を立つ。が──。
dialogues.en: I stand up. But...
dialogues.text: I stand up. But...

dialogues.jp: ぐううぅ……。
dialogues.en: Rrrumble, goes my stomach.
dialogues.text: Rrrumble, goes my stomach.

dialogues.jp:
アンポンタンポカンな空気が、天然ガスを掘り
当てたように、辺りに満ちる。
dialogues.en:
A stupid-dumb-embarrassing kind of atmosphere fills the room
as if someone struck natural gas.
dialogues.text:
A stupid-dumb-embarrassing kind of atmosphere fills the room
as if someone struck natural gas.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ご飯……作りますね」
dialogues.en: "I will...... cook right away."
dialogues.text: "I will...... cook right away."

dialogues.jp:
忘れていた笑顔を思い出すと、頼子さんは席を
立ったのだった。
dialogues.en: She remembers how to smile again and stands from her chair.
dialogues.text: She remembers how to smile again and stands from her chair.

dialogues.jp: ◆外食に行こうとしたけれど◆
dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.jp:
相変わらず外に出たがらない頼子さんをどうに
か外に連れ出す手立てはないものかと、俺は外
食に誘ってみることにした。
dialogues.en:
It's 5 pm. I was going to tell her about eating out tonight,
but then I thought of a very important issue.
dialogues.text:
It's 5 pm. I was going to tell her about eating out tonight,
but then I thought of a very important issue.

dialogues.jp:
ところが、家の外に出たとたん頼子さんは｛おび／怯｝え
の表情を浮かべ、動けなくなってしまう。
dialogues.en: That is, what she should wear outside.
dialogues.text: That is, what she should wear outside.

dialogues.jp:
彼女は外が怖くて、でも何故怖いのか、その理
由がわからないらしい。
dialogues.en:
"As I was thinking this afternoon, it's weird if a girl
walks into town, wearing a maid costume..."
dialogues.text:
"As I was thinking this afternoon, it's weird if a girl
walks into town, wearing a maid costume..."

dialogues.jp:
結局外出は取りやめたが、軽い気持ちで外に誘っ
た自分がなんだか腹立たしかった。
dialogues.en:
I don't mind it but I'll get mad if she gets a lot of
curious attention from others.
dialogues.text:
I don't mind it but I'll get mad if she gets a lot of
curious attention from others.
